description.content:
Retrieve alerts for a vehicle based on its unique ID.


Possible Codes in Error Response (see [Errors](https://docs.volteras.com/api-reference/errors) for error response schema and meaning of codes):

- AUTHENTICATION_ERROR
- PAGE_SIZE_TOO_LARGE
- PAGINATED_QUERY_FILTER_CHANGED
- REQUEST_VALIDATION_ERROR
- RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND
- SERVER_ERROR

query.description: Max size of the returned list.

variable.description: (Required) Unique internal identifier for the vehicle.
